scope: Offline 20bb tabular abstract full-game training; preflop-only export; no full-game exploitability certification or serving promotion

evaluation.exception: integrated200 uses the same evaluation counts; baseline100 reproduction omitted

caveats: Wall times are local observations, not cloud runtime promises. Some integrated runs overlapped compilation and experienced high kernel time/memory compression; use user CPU and instructions as additional cost evidence.

The evaluator policy lookup and root rollout algorithm are unchanged across estimator modes; the terminal kernel changes only training. Bit-level evaluator helpers are exhaustively tested for equivalence.
Root max selection reuses evaluation samples; nominal root lower confidence bounds are not selection corrected.
No cross-seed stability metric is proof of equilibrium.
Separate full-game neural-serving reports apply to a different model.
No checkdown baseline variance-times-cost advantage on a frozen full policy was measured; pair results are mixed.
